name: question
description:
Ask the human user for input and wait for their answer. Answers are returned as arrays of labels. Set multiple: true to allow selecting more than one option.

Direct tool-call shape: pass `questions` as a real JSON array of question objects, not a JSON string. Example: `{ "questions": [{ "header": "Select", "question": "Choose items", "multiple": true, "custom": false, "options": [{ "label": "id-1", "description": "First option" }] }] }`.

Workflow support: this tool now works inside workflow tool nodes. Pass `questions` as a real JSON array (not a string). The workflow runner uses `resolveDeep` to preserve array/object types. The session's `question` host service is wired to the `Question` runtime module, so pending questions surface through the standard API and the workflow waits for human input.

questions.description: Real JSON array of question objects. Do not pass a string. Each object may include header, question, multiple, custom, and options; options should be an array of `{label, description}` objects. In workflow tool nodes, nested arrays/objects may be stringified by the runner, so prefer direct parent-session calls.

question.description: The question text to display to the user

header.description: Optional header label shown above the question

multiple.description: If true, user can select multiple options. If false or omitted, single selection only.

custom.description: If false, disables custom text input. If true or omitted, allows typing a custom answer.

options.description: Optional list of choices. If omitted, user types a free-form answer.

label.description: The choice label shown to the user

description.description: Optional description shown beneath the label
